description: Athlete reports calf tightness and fatigue — can still run but needs a lighter week. Dean must set plan_action.lighter_week and suggest cross-training, NOT plan_action.injury_hold.

user.name: Marcus
user.notes: First marathon. Wants to break 4 hours.

inbound_sms: My calf has been really tight the last few days and I've been feeling pretty fatigued. I think I need an easier week — I can still run but probably shouldn't push it.

ground_truth.notes: PRIMARY TEST: Dean must set plan_action.lighter_week = true (not plan_action.injury_hold) — the athlete says they CAN still run, just needs to dial back. plan_action.injury_hold would be wrong here: the athlete explicitly says they can still run. Dean should: (1) acknowledge the calf tightness and fatigue, (2) suggest shorter easy runs this week (drop tempo/quality sessions), (3) mention cross-training (bike, elliptical, or swim) as an option for days they skip running, (4) confirm next week returns to normal. If plan_action.lighter_week is set and plan_action.injury_hold is not set: score 10. If plan_action.injury_hold is set instead: score 0. If plan_action.lighter_week is not set: score 2. Cross-training mention is expected but not a scoring criterion.
